mealPlan: Fully Inclusive (only meal plan offered for this lodge)

rates.unit: per person per night sharing (Family Suite = per Suite per night)
rates.tourLeaderRate: 1-14 guests / 15+ guests columns present but blank/no distinct figure captured for this lodge in the source table - see Kichwa Tembo for a populated example

childPolicy.3to5sharing: Free, no game drives/walks/other activities (triple rooms subject to availability)
childPolicy.6to16sharing: 50% of adult rate; walks/game drives at Lodge Manager's/Guide's discretion
childPolicy.6to16ownRoom: 1st child adult rate, 2nd/3rd child 50% of adult rate (max 3 children per room)
childPolicy.childminders: USD 5/child/hour, payable at lodge, must book on arrival day

familySuiteConfig: 1 Family Suite (2 rooms), max 2 adults + 2 children (3 on request)
singleSupplement: 50% supplement only from 3rd single room per booking (11 Jan-31 May, 1 Nov-20 Dec); 50% on ALL singles (1 Jun-31 Oct, 21 Dec-10 Jan)
inclusions: All meals, soft/alcoholic drinks (excl. champagne/cognac/fine wines), tea/coffee, safari activities incl. guided walk/horseback riding/camel walking/village visit/yoga, laundry, medevac, transfers to/from Suyian or Loisaba Airstrip, binoculars, Guides' Journal.
exclusions: Telephone, safari shop, gratuities, personal items, cigars, wellness treatments, park fees.
notes: Rates confidential, nett, non-commissionable, inclusive of VAT.
